Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: target $/1M token benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic/hosts

Alicia — really helpful, thank you for the populated MOI. Based on the volumes and the workload mix you provided, here's our preliminary benchmarking and assumptions to frame the pricing discussion: 

Summary (assumptions):
- Volume basis: 8–10B tokens/month steady state (we'll price tiers at 8B and 12B).
- Workload: 70% generation (avg context + response length ~1,000 tokens total), 25% embeddings (shorter calls, aggressive caching), 5% reranking.
- Pricing comparisons reflect unit cost per 1M "input+output" tokens as commonly reported. We assume similar model family/perf across providers for apples-to-apples.

Benchmarks (preliminary):
- OpenAI (hosted, comparable model): ~$200 / 1M tokens
- Anthropic (hosted, comparable model): ~$180 / 1M tokens
- Common open-model hosts/self-host (managed hosters): ~$130 / 1M tokens (depends on quantization and infra mix)
- Redwood (proposal baseline): $90 / 1M tokens with 12-month commit at 8B+/month; $75 / 1M tokens at 12B+ with a 24-month reserved commitment and predictable throughput.

Key notes / levers: 
- Committed reserved capacity (Dedicated) reduces unit cost significantly versus pure hosted pay-as-you-go.
- Caching and batching optimizations: with our KV/prefix caching assumptions for repeated prompts and embeddings we expect effective token reduction of ~8–12% on generation-heavy workloads — we bake conservative uplifts into the proposal.
- Model variant: pricing above assumes an open-model family comparable to the Anthropic/OpenAI family performance. If you require a specific closed model, we can map exact costs.

Next steps: 
1) Are the Redwood baseline numbers in the right direction vs your $100–120 target? 
2) If yes, we'll draft a 2-tier commercial with 12/24-month commitment options, including a performance SLA and an overage policy.
3) Can we book a 30-min pricing review with procurement/legal present? I'm available Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Attaching a short one-pager that shows the side-by-side comparison and the commit tiers for quick reference.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-pricing-vs-hosts-20260918.pdf
